description:
DIAGNOSED (2026-08-31 at d0535e47b, probe dumps pred.{fifo,lifo}.canon in
the session scratchpad; the clause-order and dispatch classes are fixed
by fz-kdt.104/105, isolating this cleanly):

THE 14 FIFO-only specializations on enum_predicate_search (217 vs 203)
all carry the element join int | :false | :ok | :true (or list thereof) --
a cone rooted at ONE divergent settled callsite: the erased shared spec
List.reduce_while_step/3[list(a0_e), {:cont,:true}|{:halt,:false}, a2]
exists in BOTH artifacts, but under FIFO its callsite settles as a DIRECT
call to a single WIDE List.reduce_while_cont/3[list(int|:false|:ok|:true)]
(whose cone then mints the other 13 wide keys: all?/lambda/Kernel-op
specs on the wide element), while under LIFO the same callsite settles as
a 3-ARM DISPATCH over three NARROW cont specs (one per concrete list
type). Behavior identical; LIFO's artifact is strictly more precise.

MECHANISM (the schedule-dependent state): the cumulative input JOIN is
order-independent, but the correlated ROW SET is not -- callsite targets
are minted per row (fz-9i4.7.10.2), rows are CUMULATIVE
(absence-is-not-retraction, fz-kdt.63), and mid-ascent transient rows
never leave. Under FIFO the shared spec's rows collapse/merge (or hit the
ACTIVATION_INPUT_ROW_BUDGET=8 columnwise join) into one wide row -> one
wide target; under LIFO three precise rows survive -> three narrow
targets. TO VERIFY when picked up: probe the row set of the erased step
spec at settlement under both schedules (row counts + contents); confirm
whether the budget collapse or content-merge is the collapser at FIFO.

THE CLASS: the artifact records the ASCENT PATH, not just the settled
answer -- transient wide joins that a caller passed through get demanded,
resolved, and stuck. Adjacent open tickets that any fix must reconcile:
fz-kdt.81 (correlated row carrier), fz-kdt.64 (ActivationInputs cannot
narrow -- this IS that, observed in the artifact), fz-kdt.65 (explicit
reset of accumulated evidence), fz-kdt.110 (the rising-rungs cost of
precision). FIX DIRECTION (design ground -- full ritual, cold review
before building): the row set consumed at settlement should derive from
STANDING caller conclusions (each caller's final edge contributes its
final row; a replaced conclusion's rows leave with it) rather than from
the cumulative accretion. That is the fz-kdt.69.2 CallSiteResolution
replace-semantics extended to rows -- and it likely dissolves fz-kdt.64
in the same motion.

DISPUTED SIDE-REPORT (kdt.104 round, kept for reference): a
harness-vs-production lens divergence was reported by one refuter and
NOT reproduced by the builder across all doors x5 md5-stable
(measurement-trap candidates: --dump path-syntax selects another dump
kind; a no-main fixture produces no dump). Re-verify with explicit
dump-kind syntax before treating as real.

comments.text: fz-kdt.105 measurement (post-landing, door = fz2 interp --dump backend=, release build): the FIFO-vs-LIFO key-set gap on enum_predicate_search falls from 35 keys to exactly 14. Base fba7d72e3: FIFO 217 keys, LIFO 182, 35 FIFO-only. With canonical clause order: FIFO 217, LIFO 203, 14 FIFO-only, zero LIFO-only. Every one of the surviving 14 carries the same over-wide join 'int | :false | :ok | :true' (Enum.all?/1#lambda@4125-4170/2, three Enum.all?/2#lambda@4286-4337/2, Enum.all_value_step/1, Enum.empty?/1#lambda@4753-4792/2, Kernel.</2, Kernel.==/2, Kernel.fz_op_eq/2, Kernel.fz_op_lt/2 and siblings) -- i.e. the 21 that vanished were the clause-ORDER class and the 14 that remain are exactly this ticket's transient-wide-join class, now isolated with nothing else mixed in. 00420 and 00183 are fully key-confluent FIFO vs LIFO at both base and head.

title: The artifact records the ascent path: cumulative correlated rows keep transient wide joins, and the row set is schedule-dependent (14-spec cone diagnosed)
